commands.label: Find file
commands.description: Opens a file of the workspace by its name.
examples: SPC f f, main → main.ts opens
commands.rationale: VSpaceCode, Doom Emacs and LazyVim use SPC f f and SPC SPC to find a file.

commands.label: Show recent locations
commands.description: Lists the code locations visited or changed lately, each with a line of context.
examples: SPC f l, parse → the cursor returns to the edit in parseArgs
commands.rationale: l for locations, next to the other file pickers of the File group.

vscode.note: VS Code has no list of recent locations; Go Back steps through them one at a time.
